name: Security Assertion Benchmark Suite
description: A benchmark suite comprising real-world hardware designs and corresponding golden reference assertions to evaluate large language models' ability to generate SystemVerilog security-centric assertions from natural language prompts.
reputation: A new benchmark suite proposed for evaluating security-centric assertion generation in hardware design, with emerging but not yet broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on security-centric assertion generation for hardware verification using LLMs with natural language prompts.
